module: Flowgraph node 'Select Garage Spots' (once_p_duration category, author BeamNG). Picks a start spot and an end spot among sitesData.parkingSpots: in isLocal mode, the start spot must belong to the zone 'zone' (zone with the lowest prio); the end spot is chosen at random between minDist and maxDist distance. Outputs: flow (once found), impulse loaded, startSpot, endSpot, startLocation, endLocation. The input pin descriptions are empty in the code.
notes: The log message mentions 'G2G Route' (carried over from the garage-to-garage node).
The reset (pin) is not read in work; only resetData via workOnce/_executionStarted resets to zero.
If possibleStartingSpots is empty (no spot in the zone), self.startSpot is nil and the node crashes.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: Initializes the lists, state=1 and the outputs.

resetData.desc: Empties the used spots and resets everything to zero.

findEndSpotForStartingSpot.desc: Picks an end spot at an acceptable distance from the start spot (see Select Garage Sites), otherwise the best candidate.

work.desc: If flow: state 1 selects start and end, writes the outputs, flow and loaded to true; state 2 keeps flow=true and loaded=false.
